name: singlet_perturbation_knockdown_efficacy
title: Estimate on-target knockdown per guide
description: Estimates how strongly each guide reduces (CRISPRi, CRISPRko) or raises (CRISPRa) its own target gene relative to non-targeting cells, with a confidence interval and a weak-guide flag. The default pseudobulk_nb fits a replicate-level negative-binomial model per target and can correct for ambient target RNA. mimosca, mixscape and mixscale are comparators whose outputs are scores or classes, not calibrated knockdown fractions. Needs single-guide assignments, replicate labels, raw counts and size factors; writes uns/knockdown_efficacy. Not for judging off-target effects or protein-level efficacy.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Estimator. pseudobulk_nb gives calibrated fractions with intervals; the other three return scores or classes.

design.description: Study design: count and log layers, guide and replicate columns, controls, covariates, expected direction.

count_layer.description: Raw integer UMI layer of the target genes; no normalisation is applied.

log_layer.description: Unscaled log-normalised layer used for Mixscape and Mixscale projections.

guide_key.description: obs column of single-guide assignments from perturbation.guide_assignment.

replicate_key.description: obs column of biological replicates; required because replicates are the unit of inference.

nt_label.description: Guide label of non-targeting control cells.

covariates.description: obs columns added as covariates to the model or elastic net.

direction.description: Expected direction of the target change; sets the sign of the weak-guide flag.

min_cells_per_guide.description: Guides with fewer assigned cells are skipped and reported.

pseudobulk_nb.description: Options of the pseudobulk negative-binomial model.

ambient_correction.description: Model ambient target RNA as an additive term from the ambient fraction and profile.

confidence_level.description: Coverage of the Wald intervals for beta and k.

weak_guide_upper_lfc.description: Guide flagged weak when the upper bound of its log2 fold change exceeds this value.

mixscape.description: Options of the Mixscape signature and two-component call.

min_de_genes.description: Minimum DE genes between guide and NT cells to classify a guide.

logfc_threshold.description: Log fold-change cutoff for signature genes.

iter_num.description: Iterations of the two-component mixture fit.

scale.description: Scale the signature input; false keeps unscaled log-normalised input, as the rapids-singlecell implementation specifies.

mixscale.description: Options of the Mixscale standardised projection score.

min_de_genes.description: Minimum DE genes between guide and NT cells to score a guide.

max_de_genes.description: Maximum DE genes in the signature.

logfc_threshold.description: Log fold-change cutoff for signature genes.

scale.description: Scale the signature input; false keeps unscaled log-normalised input, as the rapids-singlecell implementation specifies.

l1_ratio.description: L1 share of the elastic-net penalty.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for mixture starts in mixscape and mixscale; other methods are deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing before anything is written.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/knockdown_efficacy. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary: method, n_guides_tested, n_guides_skipped, n_guides_weak, median_knockdown, ambient_correction, device_used, seed. Per-guide estimates are in uns/knockdown_efficacy. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device, n_cells, n_guides, n_targets.
